representativeVariants.name: Editorial — outlined
representativeVariants.whySelected: Featured articles appear as grid cells separated by visible rules, with no shadow or rounded corners.

representativeVariants.name: Project — heavy rule
representativeVariants.whySelected: Project cards use a strong rectangular boundary and compact metadata rows to read like an index or catalog.

representativeVariants.name: Muted — supporting item
representativeVariants.whySelected: The blog uses #f5f5f5 card surfaces for quieter content blocks while maintaining the same square silhouette.

usageHints.priorityHint: Use outlined cards for editorial indexes and heavy-rule cards for projects; reserve muted cards for secondary information.
usageHints.a11y: When the whole card is clickable, expose one clear link target and keep heading hierarchy intact.
